data.one_liner: Provides animated onboarding pages with customizable page indicator.
data.what_it_does: OnBoardingAnimation displays a sequence of pages with smooth transitions and a configurable indicator. It wraps SmoothPageIndicator to expose many styling options for the dots.
use_when: You need a quick onboarding flow with animated page transitions
You want a highly customizable page indicator without building it from scratch
avoid_when: You require complex onboarding logic beyond simple page swipes
You need platform‑specific onboarding animations not covered by this package
weaknesses: No built‑in support for non‑linear flows or tutorials
Relies on smooth_page_indicator, adding an extra dependency

alternatives.name: smooth_page_indicator
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides similar dot indicators with fewer onboarding-specific features, allowing you to build custom page transitions yourself

data.minimal_example:
OnBoardingAnimation(
  pages: [Container(), Container(), Container()],
  indicatorDotHeight: 7.0,
  indicatorDotWidth: 7.0,
  indicatorType: IndicatorType.expandingDots,
  indicatorPosition: IndicatorPosition.bottomCenter,
);
